title: Summer and Tide
author: Noor Coldharbour
blurb: Marguerite Joubert, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
